business: SEGMENT: real estate agents, St. Louis
prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in St. Louis MO to sell my house?
engine_stated_criteria: seller-side sales in your neighborhood and price range
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent for every St. Louis home—the right fit depends on your neighborhood, price range, and property type. Based on the available results, **Angela Kittner** is a promising seller-focused candidate: Homes.com reports 112 listing-side sales in the past year, across a broad range of prices. **Dawn Griffin’s team** also has a substantial record of client reviews, including sellers.

I’d interview two or three agents before choosing. Ask each for recent **seller-side sales in your neighborhood and price range**, their suggested list price and comparable sales, marketing plan, fees, and who will handle showings and negotiations. Compare their evidence and communication—not just their overall sales count or online rating.

If you share your neighborhood or ZIP code, approximate home value, and property type, I can help narrow the shortlist.
